title: Implementation Architect
description:
**Implementation Architect**


**Location: Bengaluru/Coimbatore**


**About AppViewX:**



AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole's 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.


**Our Values**



Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.


* **We Do What We Say:** We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.


If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.


**What will you be responsible for?**



Customer Success Implementation Architects play a key role in driving Customer onboarding, Solutioning and ongoing adoption and usage of AppViewX product. You will lead the implementation of AppViewX solutions for automating customer IT Network infrastructure and Public Key Infrastructure. You will combine your deep technical knowledge with an understanding of customer business objectives /challenges help customers maximize the value of AppViewX products. You will work in the Customer Success team looking at opportunities to automate service offerings around different AppViewX products, tools and processes.


**Onboarding**


* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Address customer objectives/success criteria with in\-depth technical attention to help customer Go\-live quickly.


**Adoption and Value Quantification**


* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement additional AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Act as a trusted technical advisor by assisting customers navigate technical challenges throughout the implementation process.
* Identify new use cases as part of account growth/renewal strategy


**Customer Experience/Engagement**


* Use your experiences working with customers to provide feedback to the rest of the AppViewX organization on how we can improve the customer experience, speed time\-to\-value, and create greater benefits for our customers
* Use your experience to look at opportunities to automate, develop tools that aid your team to reduce man hours.
* Contribute to Customer Business Reviews highlighting potential areas of improvements.


 **Roadmap Planning**


* Partner closely with other cross\-functional team members (e.g., sales, product management, support, services, delivery) to translate business needs and product requirements into new solutions
* Work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to prioritize product enhancements and long term roadmap based on customer/industry priorities.


**What do we require?**


* Minimum 5 years' experience working in a technical implementation role
* Open to work in US Shift
* Minimum 3 years' experience working in customer\-facing technical roles (such as Customer Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Subject Matter Expert), preferably in a post\-sales capacity, for a SaaS company with enterprise software products
* Love of programming, solid coding skills in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Java.
* Experience with web service development and using RESTful APIs
* Understanding of configuration management tools such as Chef/Puppet/Vagrant/Ansible/Salt preferred
* Experience with building Jenkins/automated test frameworks preferred
* Domain knowledge on **PKI**, DNS, Active Directory,cloud, ADCS, CRL, OCSP, and associated cryptographic standards
* + Experience with Certificate Life Cycle management/operations
	+ Experience with PKI implementation processes
	+ Experience with PKI integrations, MS Intune, SCEP, other enrollment practices
* Hands on experience with:
* + Kubernetes
	+ Linux / Windows server management
	+ Apache, IIS \- application expertise
* CISSP / CISM / CISA is preferred
* Excellent organization, troubleshooting, problem solving, deployment and multitasking skills with ability to learn new technology at a fast pace
* Worked and interacted with F500 organizations
* Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills


**Why AppViewX?**



AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.



AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX's policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

title: AUTOSAR BSW Diagnostics Engineer with C++ for ADAS
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Location:** Bangalore / Chennai
  

**Experience:** 5–12 Years


Join a team developing advanced automotive software solutions for next\-generation ADAS and vehicle platforms. As an AUTOSAR BSW Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and enhancing Basic Software (BSW) modules, communication stacks, and diagnostic services to support high\-performance automotive systems.


### **Your Role**


You will work on AUTOSAR BSW development with a focus on communication, diagnostics, failure management, and non\-volatile memory services. You will collaborate with system architects, application teams, and integration engineers to deliver robust and scalable automotive software solutions.


### **In this role, you will:**


* Develop and maintain AUTOSAR BSW communication modules including Ethernet, SOME/IP, J1939, and CAN\-FD.
* Design and implement diagnostic services, failure management, and NVRAM (NvM) modules.
* Configure, customize, and enhance AUTOSAR Basic Software components to meet project requirements.
* Integrate and validate communication and diagnostic stacks across vehicle platforms.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software issues in embedded automotive environments.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on system integration, validation, and performance optimization.
* Participate in software architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design activities.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation and support testing activities throughout the development lifecycle.

### **Your Profile**


* Strong hands\-on experience in AUTOSAR BSW development.
* Expertise in Communication Stack development, including Ethernet, SOME/IP, J1939, and CAN\-FD.
* Experience in AUTOSAR Diagnostics, Failure Management, and NvM module development.
* Good understanding of automotive software architecture and embedded systems.
* Strong proficiency in Embedded C programming.
* Experience with automotive communication protocols and diagnostic concepts.
* Strong debugging, integration, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with automotive development and validation tools.
* ADAS Video and Radar product\-line BSW software development experience is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with automotive functional safety and software development processes is an added advantage.

### **What You'll Love About Working Here**


* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge ADAS, radar, and vision\-based automotive technologies.
* Exposure to advanced AUTOSAR platforms and communication frameworks.
* Collaborative environment with experienced automotive software engineering teams.
* Continuous learning and growth in next\-generation vehicle and mobility technologies.
**About Capgemini In India**
----------------------------


Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.Make it real \| www.capgemini.com/in\-en.


Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

description:

title: Technical Delivery Lead – Life Insurance Software Product
description:
**Technical Delivery Lead – Life Insurance Software Product**

**Company:** KGiSL Technologies Pvt Ltd  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Experience:** 15\+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Role Overview**

KGiSL is looking for an experienced **Technical Delivery Lead** with 15\+ years of experience to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of our **Life Insurance Software Product**. The role requires a strong combination of **Life Insurance domain expertise, technical delivery leadership, product implementation experience, and customer/stakeholder management**.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring successful delivery of product implementations, enhancements, and customer engagements while working closely with product, engineering, business, and customer\-facing teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of **KGiSL’s Life Insurance Software Product** across customer implementations and product enhancement initiatives.
* Own delivery planning, timelines, scope, quality, risks, dependencies, and overall delivery outcomes.
* Work closely with customers, product teams, business stakeholders, architects, project managers, and engineering teams.
* Drive implementation and delivery of Life Insurance product solutions for global customers.
* Understand and provide leadership across key **Life Insurance processes**, including new business, underwriting, policy administration, premium processing, policy servicing, claims, and policy lifecycle management.
* Translate customer and business requirements into actionable delivery plans.
* Manage multiple projects/workstreams and ensure timely delivery of agreed milestones.
* Lead delivery governance, project reviews, status reporting, risk management, and escalation management.
* Identify delivery risks and dependencies proactively and drive appropriate mitigation plans.
* Participate in customer discussions, solution reviews, steering committee meetings, and senior management reviews.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to address product gaps, enhancements, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Ensure delivery teams follow defined quality, governance, and software delivery processes.
* Lead and mentor Project Managers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, and other delivery professionals.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, product implementation, quality, and customer experience.
* Support business development and pre\-sales activities by providing delivery and domain inputs when required.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **15\+ years of experience** in software/product delivery, preferably in the insurance technology domain.
* Strong experience in **Life Insurance software products and implementations**.
* Strong understanding of Life Insurance business processes and policy administration.
* Proven experience managing complex, large\-scale product implementations or transformation programs.
* Strong delivery leadership and project/program management experience.
* Experience managing global customers and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and customer\-facing experience.
* Ability to work effectively with product, engineering, architecture, business, and customer teams.
* Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, risks, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Experience in an **Insurance Product Company / InsurTech environment**

Application Question(s):

* 1\. Are you currently residing in Coimbatore or willing to relocate to Coimbatore?
* 2\. How many years of experience do you have in Software Industry?
* 3\. How many years of experience do you have in Technical Delivery?
* 4\. How many years of experience do you have in Life Insurance?
* 5\. What is your current CTC in Lacs per annum?
* 6\. What is your expected CTC in Lacs per annum?
* 7\. What is your notice period?

Work Location: In person
